rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a smaller-than-normal version of an object, animal, or product.

example.english: I bought a miniature vacuum cleaner, and it doesn't take up space on my desk.
example.traditional: 我買咗個迷你吸塵機，擺喺書枱都唔阻地方。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 mai4 nei5 kap1 can4 gei1 baai2 hai2 syu1 ci4 dou1 m4 zo2 dei6 fong1

rows.note: Use this especially for a very small animal, particularly when describing its visibly tiny size.

example.english: Look, that miniature cat is hiding in the cardboard box!
example.traditional: 你睇，嗰隻細細隻嘅貓匿咗喺紙箱入面呀！
example.jyutping: nei5 tai2 go2 zek3 sai3 sai3 zek3 ge3 maau1 nik1 zo2 hai2 zi2 soeng1 jap6 min6 aa3
